subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub adopt this publisher-follow graph and general API-token HTTP contract as a first-class product surface now?
rationale: The code cannot decide whether permanent private follow data, its account-deletion lifecycle, and a public API-token mutation surface are intended ClawHub contracts; two additional stacked feature PRs depend on this choice.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded API slice
options.body: Approve publisher-scoped follows and the API-token contract, then require documented privacy/deletion semantics, a clean rebase, generated artifacts, and live runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep follows internal first
options.body: Land only an authenticated internal Convex model for the first-party UI and defer the public HTTP route until external API demand and scope are confirmed.

options.title: Pause the follow stack
options.body: Leave or close the draft stack until publisher discovery and notification work receives explicit product sponsorship.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded API slice
recommendation.body: Approve publisher-scoped follows and the API-token contract, then require documented privacy/deletion semantics, a clean rebase, generated artifacts, and live runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged history shows direct ownership of the authenticated HTTP API boundary and integration of contributor API work into main.
